sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_parties` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `isSelf` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_economics` (`eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `valueMinor` INTEGER, `valueBasis` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `allocationsComplete` INTEGER NOT NULL, `statPolicy` TEXT NOT NULL, `budgetPolicy` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`eventId`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`categoryId`) REFERENCES `finance_categories`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_economics_eventId` ON `finance_economics` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_economics_categoryId` ON `finance_economics` (`categoryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_funding` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `partyId` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `entryLinkId` TEXT, `basis` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`partyId`) REFERENCES `finance_parties`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`entryLinkId`) REFERENCES `finance_event_entries`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_funding_eventId` ON `finance_funding` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_funding_partyId` ON `finance_funding` (`partyId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_funding_entryLinkId` ON `finance_funding` (`entryLinkId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_shares` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER, `beneficiaryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `bearerId` TEXT, `fundingId` TEXT, `relation` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`beneficiaryId`) REFERENCES `finance_parties`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`bearerId`) REFERENCES `finance_parties`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`fundingId`) REFERENCES `finance_funding`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_shares_eventId` ON `finance_shares` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_shares_beneficiaryId` ON `finance_shares` (`beneficiaryId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_shares_bearerId` ON `finance_shares` (`bearerId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_shares_fundingId` ON `finance_shares` (`fundingId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_obligations` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `shareId` TEXT, `creditorId` TEXT NOT NULL, `debtorId` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `currencyCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`shareId`) REFERENCES `finance_shares`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`creditorId`) REFERENCES `finance_parties`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`debtorId`) REFERENCES `finance_parties`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_obligations_eventId` ON `finance_obligations` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_obligations_shareId` ON `finance_obligations` (`shareId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_obligations_creditorId` ON `finance_obligations` (`creditorId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_obligations_debtorId` ON `finance_obligations` (`debtorId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_settlements` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `obligationId` TEXT NOT NULL, `entryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`obligationId`) REFERENCES `finance_obligations`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`entryId`) REFERENCES `finance_entries`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_settlements_obligationId` ON `finance_settlements` (`obligationId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_settlements_entryId` ON `finance_settlements` (`entryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_resolutions` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `obligationId` TEXT NOT NULL, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`obligationId`) REFERENCES `finance_obligations`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_resolutions_obligationId` ON `finance_resolutions` (`obligationId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `shopping_purchases` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `currencyCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `occurredAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `shopping_purchase_lines` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `purchaseId` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `quantity` INTEGER NOT NULL, `valueMinor` INTEGER, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`purchaseId`) REFERENCES `shopping_purchases`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_shopping_purchase_lines_purchaseId` ON `shopping_purchase_lines` (`purchaseId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_purchase_allocations` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `lineId` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `valueMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `personalMinor` INTEGER, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`lineId`) REFERENCES `shopping_purchase_lines`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_purchase_allocations_lineId` ON `finance_purchase_allocations` (`lineId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_purchase_allocations_eventId` ON `finance_purchase_allocations` (`eventId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_cost_adjustments` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `entryLinkId` TEXT NOT NULL, `personalReductionMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lineId` TEXT, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`entryLinkId`) REFERENCES `finance_event_entries`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`lineId`) REFERENCES `shopping_purchase_lines`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_cost_adjustments_eventId` ON `finance_cost_adjustments` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_cost_adjustments_entryLinkId` ON `finance_cost_adjustments` (`entryLinkId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_cost_adjustments_lineId` ON `finance_cost_adjustments` (`lineId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_entry_timing` (`entryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `postedAt` INTEGER, `cashPrecision` TEXT NOT NULL, `postedPrecision` TEXT NOT NULL, `postedSource` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`entryId`), FOREIGN KEY(`entryId`) REFERENCES `finance_entries`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_entry_timing_entryId` ON `finance_entry_timing` (`entryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_account_policies` (`accountId` TEXT NOT NULL, `includedInNet` INTEGER NOT NULL, `liabilityConvention` TEXT NOT NULL, `anchorBasis` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`accountId`), FOREIGN KEY(`accountId`) REFERENCES `finance_accounts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_account_policies_accountId` ON `finance_account_policies` (`accountId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_observations` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountId` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `observedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `basis` TEXT NOT NULL, `precision` TEXT NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`accountId`) REFERENCES `finance_accounts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_observations_accountId` ON `finance_observations` (`accountId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_reconciliations` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `observationId` TEXT NOT NULL, `bookMinor` INTEGER, `fingerprint` TEXT NOT NULL, `algorithmVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `confirmationOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`observationId`) REFERENCES `finance_observations`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_reconciliations_observationId` ON `finance_reconciliations` (`observationId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_credit_cycles` (`accountId` TEXT NOT NULL, `closingDay` INTEGER NOT NULL, `dueDay` INTEGER NOT NULL, `zoneId` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`accountId`), FOREIGN KEY(`accountId`) REFERENCES `finance_accounts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_credit_cycles_accountId` ON `finance_credit_cycles` (`accountId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_drafts` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountId` TEXT, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `targetAccountId` TEXT, `amountExpression` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `occurredAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `occurredText` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `categoryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `subcategoryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `currencyCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `continuous` INTEGER NOT NULL, `epoch` INTEGER NOT NULL, `editGeneration` INTEGER NOT NULL, `nature` TEXT NOT NULL, `role` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT, `shareText` TEXT NOT NULL, `excluded` INTEGER NOT NULL, `excludedBudget` INTEGER NOT NULL, `expectedEdited` INTEGER NOT NULL, `eventUpdatedAt` INTEGER, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_draft_tags` (`draftId` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`draftId`, `name`), FOREIGN KEY(`draftId`) REFERENCES `finance_drafts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_draft_tags_draftId` ON `finance_draft_tags` (`draftId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_draft_expected` (`draftId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `expectedId` TEXT, `role` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountText` TEXT NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `cancelled` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`draftId`, `position`), FOREIGN KEY(`draftId`) REFERENCES `finance_drafts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_draft_expected_draftId` ON `finance_draft_expected` (`draftId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_economic_drafts` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT, `expectedRevision` INTEGER, `eventVersion` INTEGER, `epoch` INTEGER NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `currencyCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `occurredText` TEXT NOT NULL, `preservedOccurredAt` INTEGER, `valueText` TEXT NOT NULL, `valueBasis` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `allocationsComplete` INTEGER NOT NULL, `statExcluded` INTEGER NOT NULL, `budgetExcluded` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`categoryId`) REFERENCES `finance_categories`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_economic_drafts_eventId` ON `finance_economic_drafts` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_economic_drafts_categoryId` ON `finance_economic_drafts` (`categoryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_economic_draft_funding` (`draftId` TEXT NOT NULL, `localId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `partySelection` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountText` TEXT NOT NULL, `entryLinkSelection` TEXT, `basis` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`draftId`, `localId`), FOREIGN KEY(`draftId`) REFERENCES `finance_economic_drafts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_economic_draft_funding_draftId` ON `finance_economic_draft_funding` (`draftId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_economic_draft_shares` (`draftId` TEXT NOT NULL, `localId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `amountText` TEXT NOT NULL, `beneficiarySelection` TEXT NOT NULL, `bearerSelection` TEXT NOT NULL, `fundingLocalId` TEXT, `relation` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`draftId`, `localId`), FOREIGN KEY(`draftId`) REFERENCES `finance_economic_drafts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_economic_draft_shares_draftId` ON `finance_economic_draft_shares` (`draftId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_category_icons` (`categoryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `iconKey` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`categoryId`), FOREIGN KEY(`categoryId`) REFERENCES `finance_categories`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_category_icons_categoryId` ON `finance_category_icons` (`categoryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_saved_queries` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `specVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `specJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_budgets` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `currencyCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `limitMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `startAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `endExclusive` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`categoryId`) REFERENCES `finance_categories`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_budgets_categoryId` ON `finance_budgets` (`categoryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_category_policies` (`categoryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `burden` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`categoryId`), FOREIGN KEY(`categoryId`) REFERENCES `finance_categories`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_category_policies_categoryId` ON `finance_category_policies` (`categoryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_external_identities` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourceFamily` TEXT NOT NULL, `label` TEXT NOT NULL, `digestNamespace` TEXT NOT NULL, `localDigest` TEXT, `matchUsable` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_instruments` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `label` TEXT NOT NULL, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `finance_external_identities`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_instruments_identityId` ON `finance_instruments` (`identityId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_account_bindings` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `instrumentId` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountId` TEXT NOT NULL, `validFrom` INTEGER NOT NULL, `validUntil` INTEGER, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`instrumentId`) REFERENCES `finance_instruments`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`accountId`) REFERENCES `finance_accounts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_account_bindings_instrumentId` ON `finance_account_bindings` (`instrumentId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_account_bindings_accountId` ON `finance_account_bindings` (`accountId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_evidence` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `provider` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourceFamily` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityId` TEXT, `instrumentId` TEXT, `referenceKind` TEXT NOT NULL, `referenceDigest` TEXT, `digestNamespace` TEXT NOT NULL, `capturedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `summary` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityRevision` INTEGER, `bindingId` TEXT, `bindingRevision` INTEGER, `relatedOrderDigest` TEXT, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `finance_external_identities`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`instrumentId`) REFERENCES `finance_instruments`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`bindingId`) REFERENCES `finance_account_bindings`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_evidence_identityId` ON `finance_evidence` (`identityId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_evidence_instrumentId` ON `finance_evidence` (`instrumentId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_evidence_bindingId` ON `finance_evidence` (`bindingId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_extractions` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `evidenceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `extractorVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER, `currencyCode` TEXT, `occurredAt` INTEGER, `direction` TEXT, `issue` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`evidenceId`) REFERENCES `finance_evidence`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_extractions_evidenceId` ON `finance_extractions` (`evidenceId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_evidence_proposals` (`evidenceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `proposalId` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`evidenceId`, `proposalId`), FOREIGN KEY(`evidenceId`) REFERENCES `finance_evidence`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`proposalId`) REFERENCES `finance_proposals`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_evidence_proposals_evidenceId` ON `finance_evidence_proposals` (`evidenceId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_evidence_proposals_proposalId` ON `finance_evidence_proposals` (`proposalId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_media_links` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `mediaAssetId` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT, `purchaseId` TEXT, `proposalId` TEXT, `sourceHash` TEXT NOT NULL, `label` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`purchaseId`) REFERENCES `shopping_purchases`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`proposalId`) REFERENCES `finance_proposals`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_media_links_eventId` ON `finance_media_links` (`eventId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_media_links_purchaseId` ON `finance_media_links` (`purchaseId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_media_links_proposalId` ON `finance_media_links` (`proposalId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_media_links_mediaAssetId` ON `finance_media_links` (`mediaAssetId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_review_sessions` (`proposalId` TEXT NOT NULL, `baseRevision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `epoch` INTEGER NOT NULL, `amountText` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountId` TEXT, `category` TEXT NOT NULL, `subcategory` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `state` TEXT NOT NULL, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `targetAccountId` TEXT, `occurredAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `occurredText` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `tagsText` TEXT NOT NULL, `nature` TEXT NOT NULL, `role` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT, `eventUpdatedAt` INTEGER, `shareText` TEXT NOT NULL, `excluded` INTEGER NOT NULL, `excludedBudget` INTEGER NOT NULL, `expectedEdited` INTEGER NOT NULL, `costReductionText` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`proposalId`), FOREIGN KEY(`proposalId`) REFERENCES `finance_proposals`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_review_sessions_proposalId` ON `finance_review_sessions` (`proposalId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_review_expected` (`proposalId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `expectedId` TEXT, `role` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountText` TEXT NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `cancelled` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`proposalId`, `position`), FOREIGN KEY(`proposalId`) REFERENCES `finance_review_sessions`(`proposalId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_review_expected_proposalId` ON `finance_review_expected` (`proposalId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_purpose_grants` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `purpose` TEXT NOT NULL, `providerId` TEXT NOT NULL, `allowAmount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `allowDate` INTEGER NOT NULL, `allowDescription` INTEGER NOT NULL, `expiresAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_grant_events` (`grantId` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`grantId`, `eventId`), FOREIGN KEY(`grantId`) REFERENCES `finance_purpose_grants`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`eventId`) REFERENCES `finance_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_grant_events_grantId` ON `finance_grant_events` (`grantId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_grant_events_eventId` ON `finance_grant_events` (`eventId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_grant_entries` (`grantId` TEXT NOT NULL, `entryId` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`grantId`, `entryId`), FOREIGN KEY(`grantId`) REFERENCES `finance_purpose_grants`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, FOREIGN KEY(`entryId`) REFERENCES `finance_entries`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_grant_entries_grantId` ON `finance_grant_entries` (`grantId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_grant_entries_entryId` ON `finance_grant_entries` (`entryId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_command_receipts` (`operationId` TEXT NOT NULL, `command` TEXT NOT NULL, `inputDigest` TEXT NOT NULL, `resultId` TEXT NOT NULL, `epoch` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`operationId`))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_control` (`id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `restoreEpoch` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_recovery_groups` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `epoch` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `consumedAt` INTEGER, `afterFingerprint` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_recovery_entries` (`groupId` TEXT NOT NULL, `entryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountId` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountCurrencyCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `direction` TEXT NOT NULL, `amountMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `occurredAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `recordedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT, `voidedAt` INTEGER, `statPolicy` TEXT NOT NULL, `budgetPolicy` TEXT NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `importBatchId` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`groupId`, `entryId`), FOREIGN KEY(`groupId`) REFERENCES `finance_recovery_groups`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_recovery_entries_groupId` ON `finance_recovery_entries` (`groupId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `finance_recovery_links` (`groupId` TEXT NOT NULL, `linkId` TEXT NOT NULL, `eventId` TEXT NOT NULL, `entryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `role` TEXT NOT NULL, `allocatedMinor` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `voidedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`groupId`, `linkId`), FOREIGN KEY(`groupId`) REFERENCES `finance_recovery_groups`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_finance_recovery_links_groupId` ON `finance_recovery_links` (`groupId`)
